summary: 27-year-old Dylan Wallace of Steamboat Springs/Salida died during a private three-boat kayak trip on the Arkansas River north of Buena Vista when his kayak became trapped in a powerful churning feature at the bottom of Class V Pine Creek Rapid; the boat eventually flushed out and fellow kayakers pulled him to shore and attempted CPR, unsuccessful; pronounced deceased at the scene by the Chaffee County coroner; first Arkansas River fatality in AHRA territory that year
location: Pine Creek Rapid, Arkansas River below Pine Creek access point, north of Buena Vista
responding_agency: Chaffee County Sheriff's Office; Arkansas Headwaters Recreation Area rangers; Chaffee County Fire; Chaffee County EMS
notes: Mountain Mail article opened and parent-verified 2026-09-15: 5:30 p.m. call to Chaffee dispatch, multi-agency response; river running 1,670 cfs near peak snowmelt; victim an experienced whitewater kayaker with appropriate equipment.
